facts.text: The property was originally built in 1908 by Alfred Gwynne Vanderbilt.
facts.excerpt: Originally built in 1908 by scion Alfred Gwynne Vanderbilt

facts.text: The interiors were reimagined by the design collective SWOON.
facts.excerpt: the renovated property was conceived by design collective, SWOON

facts.text: The hotel features a commissioned series by photographer and artist Maxine Helfman.
facts.excerpt: a commissioned series throughout the hotel by photographer and artist Maxine Helfman

facts.text: The Library is a parlor near the lobby with a hidden honor bar and a secret door to a coral-coated liquor cabinet.
facts.excerpt: Beneath the scenic wallpaper, a secret door can be found to a coral-coated liquor cabinet, stocked with thoughtful provisions.

facts.text: The Conservatory serves breakfast, lunch and afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: The Conservatory** plays host to breakfast, lunch and afternoon tea

facts.text: The Roof Deck is a rooftop bar with views of Newport Harbor.
facts.excerpt: the popular rooftop bar, The Roof Deck, which offers sweeping views of Newport Harbor

facts.text: Chef April Bloomfield curated dishes at The Dining Room at The Vanderbilt, whose menu features New England classics.
facts.excerpt: The forward-thinking menu of approachable, New England classics

facts.text: The hotel has a spa and fitness center with indoor and outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: The Vanderbilt presents a spa and fitness center with indoor and outdoor pools

facts.text: Guests can take a private tour of Matunuck Oyster Farm to learn how oysters are cultivated.
facts.excerpt: to provide guests with a private tour to learn about the process of cultivating this New England favorite while enjoying champagne and cooked oysters

facts.text: Guests can join a hands-on tour of furniture maker Jonathan Glatt's showroom in Warren, Rhode Island.
facts.excerpt: will offer guests an exclusive hands-on tour and a behind-the-scenes look at the art of furniture making in his 20,000-square-foot showroom in Warren, R.I.

facts.text: Guests can visit a neighboring shipbuilder's workshop to see antique boat restoration.
facts.excerpt: to provide guests with a glimpse into the craft of authentic antique boat restoration

facts.text: A number of suites can be connected to each other, which suits families and groups.
facts.excerpt: A number of suites have the possibility to be connected to each other, an excellent option for families and groups.

facts.text: Entry-level rooms are on the cozy side.
